title: Research: nine-stage bridge schedules force the 16/32/48 idle alphabet (negative, no new kappa)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"Matarener"} -->
_Requested by **Mark**_

**Negative, scoped result. No new κ, no supplier change.** Adds only `research/nine-stage-bridge-alphabet/`.

Before: every recent complex word pays idle children of ranks 8/16/32/48 from the nine-stage data route. It was open whether a redesigned route could give other ranks (`frontier1094-fixed-route-packing-cap`, open question 2). In the relaxed PR3633 packing model with the PR3653 supplier, other alphabets would be worth up to **+0.755%** on the complex root (0.0017434846, above the bit claim 0.0017366). Merging pair 2's prefix 32+8 into 40 is one example.

After: within bridge-based schedules, that alphabet is forced. In RECIPE-9, the bridges read the riding pair at levels 2j−1 and 2j, which splits its prefix. An exact census of all simple-riding bridge schedules finds no alternative that closes.

## Result

- Exact rule: the eight-wire check from `research/e8-complex-gauge-kernel/code/replay_gk.py` (`global_check`), copied verbatim. RECIPE-9 closes, the level model reproduces DATA-PHASES idle ranks on all 112 ports, and the closure test recovers RECIPE-9's three final bridges.
- Final bridges generate exactly {diag(A, A^−T): A ∈ SL(4,Z)}, so closure is decided exactly and the completing bridges are constructed explicitly.
- Census: there are 2,037,336 simple-riding designs with 271 idle alphabets. Of the 37,968 alternating designs, **exactly 16 close, all with the incumbent alphabet**. 0 of 728 designs of the best relaxed alternative (+0.336%) close. 0 of 2,000 deterministically sampled non-alternating designs close.
- Recorded searches (not in `verify.py`): one free bridge (70,688 insertions) and two free bridges (about 2.6M insertions, all 728 designs) give no closure.

## Scope

This is a search inside the stated class, not an impossibility theorem. Two-stage riding, |q|>1 bridges inside the schedule, other coupling mechanisms and local-word changes are not covered. Packing prices are relaxed-LP planning numbers (no chronology). Open next questions are in README/TASK.json.

## Verify

```sh
python3.12 -B research/nine-stage-bridge-alphabet/verify.py   # ~3 min, standard library
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/nine-stage-bridge-alphabet
```

Locally on Windows (Python 3.12): `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE ... outcome=negative-result`. `tests/test_research_*.py` shows 17 failures/errors in export/git-spelling/plan-explanation tests. They are environment-related on Windows and unrelated to this package.

Found and checked by Claude (Anthropic) via Claude Code in a session donated by Mark. No human or formal review is claimed. Apache-2.0.
